round1_new.phrase: The world cannot hate you, but it hates me because I testify that its works are evil.
Stop judging by mere appearances, but instead judge correctly.

round3_new.statement: When Jesus' brothers urged Him to go up to the feast in Judea, He told them to go on without Him because His time had not yet fully come.
round3_new.explanation: John 7:8 records Jesus saying, "You go to the festival. I am not going up to this festival, because my time has not yet fully come." He was following the Father's schedule, not His brothers' pressure.

round3_new.statement: Jesus told the crowd to judge Him by His family background and outward appearance.
round3_new.explanation: Jesus said the opposite in John 7:24: "Stop judging by mere appearances, but instead judge correctly." He wanted people to look past the surface — where He came from, what He looked like — and judge with truth and wisdom.

round3_new.statement: After hearing Jesus' teaching at the feast, some in the crowd said that He must be "the Prophet" that God had promised long ago.
round3_new.explanation: John 7:40 says, "On hearing his words, some of the people said, 'Surely this man is the Prophet.'" They were thinking of Deuteronomy 18:15-18, where Moses promised that God would one day raise up a prophet like him. Not everyone agreed, but the Prophet claim was a real option the crowd considered.
